set.body: Build an optional cross-platform scala-zarr-codec-blosc-zstd provider without adding dependencies to scalafim-zarr core. Use the normative Zarr v3 blosc metadata profile, blosc-java on JVM, and an audited embedded-WASM Blosc implementation on Scala.js. Prove direct and sharded reads, JVM writes, Scala.js encode/decode where conforming, bounded decode, corruption failures, Python differential interoperability, and artifact/deployment size. Record a Go/NoGo for neuroimaging use, explicitly testing the browser encoder's typesize boundary rather than weakening metadata semantics.
set.title: Zarr Z7 experiment: external Blosc/Zstd provider on JVM and Scala.js
